scope: Frozen exact-source/prebuilt SQL flex anatomy, computed min/font/padding/button sizes, actual text line fragments, outer/pre scroll metrics and raw CDP quads. Trusted code wheel/end/residual/reverse and keyboard focus, then normal Steps and Collapse/reopen lifetime are observed without scrollTop/focus/content/React injection or imposed overflow. Four established100/150 wide/narrow viewports; one explicitly exploratory640×400/150 viewport is added only if all four have no outer overflow. Source/selection/filter/sort/grid scroll stay retained. CSSOM extent rounding and allocated-band limitations are explicit. No Copy activation, clipboard, native/Wasm UI parity, engine or physical-input claim.

derivation.method: Read-only extraction of original immutable DOM/CDP/style/metric/capture values. All35 original PNG identities retained; only6 states retain detailed anatomy (five defaults and exploratory outer-end). Scroll/lifetime scalar metrics remain in actions. No raw file modified or screenshot recomposed.
derivation.cssom_rounding: CSSOM scroll/client extents are independently rounded; actual fractional scrollTop and raw quads are authoritative observations. Allocated bands do not certify native thumb ink.
derivation.model: Full synthetic model/cells, events and selected DOM text outside the fixed SQL are omitted; unchanged-source assertions remain in the original passed run.
derivation.formula_scope: Pure-layout formulas below are derived from measured100/150 percent font intrinsics; other scales retain geometric invariants, not new reference pixel acceptance.

derived_rules.copy_width: 37*s + 2 + ceil(47.09375*s*64)/64; frozen11-point label advance and observed1/64-point layout ceil
derived_rules.steps_width: 37*s + 2 + ceil(27.984375*s*64)/64; frozen11-point label advance and observed1/64-point layout ceil
derived_rules.code_padding: 14*s on each side; actual-text scrollbar allocation is App-owned, not derivable from count
derived_rules.title_glyph_box: floor(17*s) high, centered in35*s minus1-point bottom border; paint slot remains a separate native concern

observed_lifetime.narrow_150: Outer0; code reaches5.333333492279053 CSS units; normal Steps→SQL and Collapse→Expand→SQL reset code0.
observed_lifetime.exploratory_short_150: Code frame0; outer reaches5.333333492279053 CSS units. Same aside persists through Steps→SQL and retains that outer offset; Collapse unmounts it and resets outer0. Do not infer identical outer reset from code reset.
